name: inspira-encrypted-text
blurb: Text characters cycle through random symbols until focused or hovered.
description: Each character animates between random symbols and the actual letter, synced to a per-character cycle. Reveals on focus, hover, or when no input activity detected.
use_when: Sensitive data fields, passwords, or playful content reveals that reward interaction.
avoid_when: Primary body copy — decryption animation distracts and conflicts with normal reading flow.
a11y: Text is readable on focus but animation runs freely otherwise. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
